_doc: SEOSONA curated SFX library. Built from 'Sound Effects Pack' by scripts/build_sfx_library.sh (trim + tail-fade + loudnorm). The engine (4_BRAIN/native_composer.py) mixes these per-component at scene timestamps.

transition.use: Played at every scene change (alternates swish/whoosh).

impact.use: Punch on a big-number / stat reveal (bignum component).

ui.use: positive = badge/CTA reveal; click = step / list item.

typing.use: Keyboard bed under a terminal component.

riser.use: Short lift into the hook / a major reveal.

tick.use: Urgency/deadline tension — triggered by countdown/deadline keywords (_SEMANTIC_SFX).

shutter.use: Camera-shutter snapshot on a screenshot/capture/proof reveal (_SEMANTIC_SFX).

provenance.typing/keyboard.mp3: Typing/Keyboard, Apple Magic, Typing, Short Phrases.mp3
